title: MatchSuggestion
description: A machine-made suggestion that one person meet another, and why. Written by the service that made it, on the vault of the person it advises (`subject`), readable by them and that service. Derived, so never more readable than its sources: where a source may not be read by the subject, `reason` says only in general terms what the two have in common and quotes nothing from it. Immutable: a later judgement supersedes it; status `withdrawn` says an earlier suggestion no longer holds; `noCommonGround` answers a request that found nothing.

id.description: Stable id chosen by the writer when the record is made. Not the envelope id, which the vault assigns; references to the record use the envelope URI

subject.description: The person advised; the owner of the vault this record is on

counterpart.description: The person they are advised to meet

status.description: What this record says about the pair

reason.description: Why the two should talk, addressed to the subject, in `language`

opener.description: A first question the subject could ask, in `language`

derivedFrom.description: The records this rests on — typically both people's Wishlists. A reference gives no access to a record

request.description: The MatchRequest this answers, when it answers one

supersedes.description: The earlier suggestion for the same pair that this one replaces

provenance.description: Who made this suggestion and how. Kept for improving matching and for any reader judging how far to trust it; not meant to be shown to the people it concerns

model.description: The language model, as its provider names it

algorithm.description: The method, named by the generator

confidence.description: How sure the generator is that the two have a real reason to talk

createdAt.description: When the suggestion was made, RFC 3339
